rows.grounds: demonstrative pronoun referring to the previously described yantra
relative pronoun introducing the agent of worship
verb expressing the prescribed act of worship
adverb indicating regularity of the worship
compound denoting death occurring before its proper time
verb stating the removal of untimely death

items.question: What protection from untimely death results from daily worship of this yantra?
premises: This yantra is the previously described Mṛtyuñjaya instrument.
A person may worship this yantra daily.
Untimely death is destroyed for that worshipper.
items.inference: Daily worship of this yantra removes untimely death.
items.plain_english: Whoever worships this yantra daily has untimely death destroyed.
